The v2 proposal is preserved as presented; its old pending text is historical, not this checkpoint's execution state. This checkpoint was advanced after substantive records, navigation, reviews, dossier and final validation. No historical certainty or user acceptance follows from readiness.

DEC-0004 follows the preserved readiness audit: user approval is provisional and does not change historical confidence. Checkpoint updated after approval/decision, navigation and journal writes; Git success must be confirmed from the actual command results.

Current reopening DEC-0005: prior acceptance/stop/counts refer to earlier edition. Existing scope/limits preserved, snapshot persisted and source/claim/review identities allocated. Next reconstruct decisions, challenge, review, validate and checkpoint last.

Edition 2 current checkpoint: [usefulness-review.md](usefulness-review.md) and completion addendum govern. Source/claim/review/dependency/index/journal/usage records persisted first. Final check:library passed; live local browser checked all home cards, roots, middle-page pagination and final boundaries. All three books now review-ready-qualified under explicit goal; user acceptance pending. Exact operating continuity, payer, economics and AI outcomes remain qualified. Prior pending/stop/typecheck wording is historical.
